main_text.l: duali ac plurali numero, & in ultima syl-
indicativi ημι vertunt in αιμην; secundæ, αμαι in αιμην. ut: τιθεμαι, τιθειμην: ιστημαι, ιστειμην.
tivo est brevis, aut constat ex diphthon-
go cum υ. ut: τετυμμένος εἴην, δεδεμένος εἴην, λελυμένος εἴην, τετρυμμένος εἴην.]
in quibus nulla fit circumlocutio tertiæ

page.notes: Greek text is partly worn and was transcribed approximately; accents and breathings in the Greek are uncertain. Marginal numerals III, II, III are section marks. Last line continues on the next page (tiæ catchword-like at foot right).
